issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a service method named addParent(Person person, Person parent). In the solution implementation the method is named registerParent(Person person, Person parent), while other components (e.g., PersonResource and tests) still call addParent. This name mismatch creates confusion and can lead to compilation errors or unexpected failures when students follow the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the identifier across all artifacts. Rename the solution method registerParent to addParent (or add a delegating addParent method that calls registerParent) so the service method name matches the problem statement, template, controller, and tests. Ensure all references use the same method name.
